title: Split lines into words and count them across lines
task: Write `Words(line string) []string` in package `text` that splits a line into words on any run of spaces or tabs, trims surrounding commas and periods, and lowercases. A second use case counts word frequency across many lines; provide a way to do that which builds on `Words`. I would rather callers did not have to pass in something for the function to fill. Test an empty line, punctuation trimming, and a multi-line count.
